name: DevRev
description: Interact with your DevRev workspace to search your enterprise knowledge graph and manage customer-product relationships. Query and update issues, tickets, enhancements, and customer data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DevRev to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DevRev to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.devrev.ai/mcp/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DevRev MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DevRev lists 14 MCP tools, including create_issue, update_issue, get_issue, list_issues, create_ticket, update_ticket, get_ticket, get_enhancement, update_enhancement, list_enhancements, get_part, and hybrid_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DevRev?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DevRev in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and Front.
DevRev requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DevRev is developed by DevRev. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
